Hi Samantha — Karthik from Solutions Engineering here. Thanks for the sample and the brief. A couple of technical clarifications so we size the demo environment correctly:

1) Model and token profile: which model family are you prototyping (open LLM / private model)? Also typical request token length distribution (p50/p90 here).
2) Burst shape: is the spike you mentioned sustained from many concurrent users (fan-out) or a smaller number of clients sending many requests?
3) SLA targets: you wrote 120ms median at 512 tokens under 400 qps sustained for short windows — do you have a 95th percentile target as well?

Suggested agenda for the 45m session:
- 0–5m: intros & success criteria
- 5–15m: infra topology and how Dedicated pools handle KV caching / prefix caching
- 15–35m: replay of your telemetry (we'll run two short bursts) + live readouts (latency histograms, tail latency, GPU utilization)
- 35–45m: recommendations (batching, quantization, routing policies) + action items

Availability: Wed 22 Feb 09:30–11:00 PT or Thu 23 Feb 13:00–14:30 PT. If those don't work, propose a slot and we'll try to accommodate.
